name: Quandrix Command
oracle_text:
Choose two —
• Return target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
• Counter target artifact or enchantment spell.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
• Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.
blocked_sentences: • Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.

needs.what: a target spec owned by one mode of a choose_mode spell whose count is caster-chosen ("up to three target cards", count 3 with up_to: true), so the stored target refs for that mode can be of variable length (0-3) while the other chosen modes' refs are still located correctly
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Targets carry `mode` and `up_to`, and the sibling-target clause `owner: {"target": "shuffler"}` with put_on_top + shuffle expresses the effect, but the loader (cards/loader/targets.py) refuses `variable_size` on a mode-owned target: `filter_legal` splits the stored refs by position per mode and a caster-chosen size leaves no way to say where the next mode's refs begin. Declaring the target at card level without `mode` would force the targets even when the mode is not chosen, and a fixed count of 3 would make the mode illegal with fewer than three cards and forbid choosing fewer.
